blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
"SELECT id, org_id, number, total_cents, issued_on FROM invoices WHERE id = $1",
[id],
findings.recommendation: Insecure direct object reference (CWE-639 / CWE-862). Any signed-in user of organization A who sends `GET /invoices/42` receives invoice 42 of organization B: the handler never reads `currentUser(req)` and the query filters on the id alone, so ids can be enumerated to read every customer's invoices. Scope the query to the caller's organization (`WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2`, `[id, currentUser(req).orgId]`) so a foreign invoice answers 404, and add a test asserting the org filter, as the list endpoint's test does.
findings.title: GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice

findings.recommendation: Information exposure through an error message (CWE-209). Any client, even unauthenticated, that sends a malformed JSON body with `Content-Type: application/json` makes `express.json()` raise a parse error that reaches this handler, and gets back the stack trace with server file paths and dependency layout; a database error raised in the invoice handlers would likewise return the driver's message (table, column or constraint names). Log the error server-side only and answer a generic `{ "error": "internal error" }`; honour `err.status`/`err.statusCode` (e.g. 400 for body-parser errors) instead of always answering 500.
findings.title: Error handler returns the error message and stack trace to the client

findings.recommendation: `Number()` accepts `0x10`, `1e3`, ` 5 `, negative values and integers beyond 2^53 (`99999999999999999999` passes `Number.isInteger`), so the path parameter is not validated against an allow-list. Whether an out-of-range value makes the database raise an error (then leaked through R-security-2) depends on the column type, which the change does not show. Validate with `/^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$/` (or `Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0`) and answer 400 otherwise.
findings.title: Invoice id is not restricted to a positive safe integer
